spans.s: शाखा [śākhā], 1 A branch (as of a tree); आवर्ज्य शाखाः
A part of subdivision of a work.
A part or division of an animal.
A school or traditional recension of the Veda, the traditional text followed by a school; as in शाखलशाखा, आश्वलायनशाखा, बाष्कलशाखा &c.
A branch of any science. -Comp. -अध्येतृ a follower of any particular text of the Veda.-अन्तग a. one who has finished one शाखा;

.-चङ्क्रमणम् 'leaping from branch to branch', irregular study. -चन्द्रन्यायः see under न्याय. -नगरम्, -पुरम् a suburb; प्रवेशयेच्च तान् सर्वान् शाखानगरकेष्वपि. -पित्तम् inflammation of the extremities of the body, e. g. hands, shoulders &c. -बाहुः a branch-like arm. -भृत् m. a tree.-भेदः difference of (Vedic) school.
मृगः a monkey, an ape; एतां दृष्ट्वा स्त्रियो मे$न्या यथा शाखामृगस्त्रियः

a squirrel. -रण्डः 'a traitor to his Śākhā', a Brāhmaṇa who has changed his own school of the Vedas. -रथ्या a branch-road. -वातः pain in the limbs.-विलीन a. sitting on branches (as a bird). -शिफा a root growing from a branch (as of the fig-tree).
Belonging to any branch or school (as of the Veda). -m.
A tree; कुल्याम्भोभिः पवनचपलैः शाखिनो धौतमूलाः Ś.1.15.
A follower of any Vedic school or recension.
शाखीय [śākhīya], a. Belonging to a school of the Veda. शाखोटः, शाखोटकः*** N. of a tree; Trophis Aspera (Mar. हेदी); कस्त्वं भो कथयामि दैवहतकं मां विद्धि शाखोटकम् K.
शाख् [śākh], 1 P. (शाखति) To pervade, fill completely.
] (nom. सखा, सखायौ, सखायः; acc. सखायम्, सखायौ, सख्युः gen sing.; सख्यौ loc. sing.) A friend, companion, an associate; तस्मात् सखा त्वमसि यन्मम तत्तवैव
. (At the end of comp. सखि is changed to सख; वनितासखानाम्
सखी [sakhī], A female friend or companion, a lady's maid; नृत्यति युवतिजनेन समं सखि विरहिजनस्य दुरन्ते
सखीयति [sakhīyati], Den. P. To wish for a friend.
Friendship, intimacy, alliance; मुमूर्च्छ सख्यं रामस्य समानव्यसने हरौ
